## 📝 About Me Section (Main Bio)

Hi there! 👋 Welcome to my page!

I'm an open-source developer passionate about building fast, modern, and self-hostable web applications. My flagship open-source project is **[MailHub](https://github.com/kawing11a/mailhub)** — a modern, multi-tenant email management platform built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, and Meilisearch.

### ✉️ Why MailHub?
Managing multiple email accounts across personal, work, and team domains can be chaotic. I created **MailHub** to give developers, privacy enthusiasts, and teams complete control over their email infrastructure with:
- **Multi-Account & Multi-Tenant**: Unifying IMAP/SMTP, Gmail OAuth, and Microsoft Outlook OAuth into one dashboard.
- **Instant Full-Text Search**: Powered by Meilisearch across all connected mailboxes.
- **High-Performance Background Sync**: Scalable background workers powered by BullMQ & Redis.
- **Team Access Control**: Granular per-member mailbox permissions for organization workspaces.
- **PWA & Web Push**: Installable desktop/mobile experience with real-time push notifications.
